caption: The drawing depicts a decorative, horseshoe-shaped wall sconce with two candle holders and a separate, smaller side view of a single candle holder at the bottom right. The main structure is outlined in gray and decorated with alternating green and red diamond and rectangular shapes. At the top center of the arch, there is a round medallion featuring red and gray, topped by three feather or leaf-like shapes painted in green and red. Each side of the arch widens at the bottom, ending in red, flared bases. The candle holders are mounted at the lower portions of the arch, each supporting a beige candle with a black wick, depicted as partially melted with irregular edges and drips. The holders themselves are gray and circular with petal-like elements beneath each candle. In the bottom right, a side view of one candle holder shows the gray base, red backplate, beige candle, and black wick in profile. In the lower left corner of the drawing, six color swatches in beige, three shades of gray, red, and green are arranged in a 2x3 grid. The composition is drawn on an off-white background.
title: Candlestick Sconce
